name: wavebound-skills
description: Wavebound's company skill library for Claude Code — role-based skill bundles (developers, legal, marketing, ...) installable as plugins.

plugins.name: dev-skills
plugins.description: Developer skills: /tldr and /tldr-extended collapse a long or technical Claude Code session into a plain-English summary with one committed recommendation; /fable-review is the fresh-eyes final review before work ships, with reviewers pinned to the bundled fable-reviewer agent (Opus, effort high).
